_meta.purpose: Shared catalog of canonical tool configurations. Per-table formalizations reference these by tool_id. Each entry is audited once at library-add time; subsequent per-table uses inherit the audit.
_meta.audit_policy: New entries require code-level audit (tool function correctness on the declared input shape) plus a one-paragraph description noting what conventions/cell-formats it handles.

stats_mean_strict.description: Mean over a column. Cells must be pure numeric (int / decimal); non-numeric cells are skipped and trigger ADR-007 coverage downgrade. Use for clean numeric columns.

stats_mean_leading_int.description: Mean using leading-int parsing: cells like '17 (R&B)', '8 (annot)', '5 *' are parsed as the leading integer (17, 8, 5). Pure integers also accepted. Non-leading-int cells are skipped (coverage downgrade).

stats_mean_leading_number.description: Like leading_int but accepts leading decimals too (e.g., '3.4 km' → 3.4). Useful for unit-bearing columns where the unit is a constant suffix.

stats_sum_strict.description: Sum over a numeric column; non-numeric cells skipped (coverage downgrade).

stats_sum_leading_number.description: Sum with leading-number parsing (handles unit suffixes).

stats_count_distinct.description: Count of distinct values in a column. Universal.

stats_count_where.description: Count of rows satisfying a Cond. Universal — Cond is provided per-call by the solver.

stats_max_strict.description: Max value over a numeric column; non-numeric skipped.

stats_min_strict.description: Min value over a numeric column; non-numeric skipped.

stats_argmax_with_id_strict.description: Argmax over a numeric column; returns (row_idx, identity_column_value, value). Per-table tool instance MUST bind identity_column at instance level (not call-time), per R10's authoritative-lift principle.

stats_argmax_with_id_leading_int.description: Argmax with leading-int parsing of the measure column.

cell_lookup.description: Look up a cell by (row_handle, column). Universal — produces L1 CellAt.

stats_topk_sum_strict.description: Sum of the top-k values of a numeric column.

stats_topk_mean_strict.description: Mean of the top-k values of a numeric column.

stats_topk_sum_by_strict.description: Sum of target_column over the top-k rows ranked by rank_by_column.

stats_topk_mean_by_strict.description: Mean of target_column over the top-k rows ranked by rank_by_column.
